name: fibbers
description: A bottom-nav dashboard plugin for Home Assistant: a viewport-pinned bottom bar, modal sheets, self-computing room tiles, and dark theming. Lit + Tailwind web components, bundled to a single file.

scripts.build: bun run gen-tw && bun build src/index.js --outfile dist/fibbers.js --format=iife --target=browser --banner="/*! Fibbers v0.2.0 — GENERATED from src/ by 'bun run build'. Do not hand-edit. */"
scripts.watch: bun build src/index.js --outfile dist/fibbers.js --format=iife --target=browser --banner="/*! Fibbers v0.2.0 — GENERATED from src/ by 'bun run build'. Do not hand-edit. */" --watch
